stage_b_reviewed_content.statement:
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$.
Let $T \subset |X|$ be a closed subset. Let $X_{/T}$ be the
formal completion of $X$ along $T$.
\begin{enumerate}
\item If $X \setminus T \to X$ is quasi-compact,
then $X_{/T}$ is locally adic*.
\item If $X$ is locally Noetherian, then $X_{/T}$ is locally
Noetherian.
\end{enumerate}
hypotheses:
Let $S$ be a scheme. Let $X$ be an algebraic space over $S$.
Let $T \subset |X|$ be a closed subset. Let $X_{/T}$ be the
formal completion of $X$ along $T$.

reason: An étale affine scheme atlas of X pulls back completion along T to affine completions; the quasi-compact complement and locally Noetherian conditions transfer chartwise.
